verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents its own mail import ('Import your mail', 'Move from Gmail'), and several community users confirm the migration tool and Gmail migrator work well for ingesting mail and calendars. Nothing in the pack shows contacts import, and the docs appear only as titles, with no detail on how complete the history import is or which providers and clients are supported. Missing for 10: contacts import evidence, documented detail on full-history import scope and supported source providers/clients.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client

citations.quote: Fastmail has an easy migration tool if you don't want to go the IMAP route.
the Gmail migrator works great, too.
The Gmail integration for ingesting mail and calendars works fantastically.
